# Gibous Duel Arena

Gibous is a Telegram Mini App for server-authoritative competitive duels.

- The server owns rooms, turns, balances, escrow, and settlement state.
- TON Connect submissions remain pending until an indexer verifies the matching transfer.
- Production requires PostgreSQL, Telegram init-data verification, and a configured native-asset deposit verifier.

The repository is the source of truth for implementation details.

- [TON Connect transaction guidance](https://docs.ton.org/v3/guidelines/ton-connect/guidelines/sending-transactions)
